recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist vertical stack of three distinct modes of transportation—a vintage propeller plane, a multi-masted sailing ship, and a steam locomotive—arranged against a divided landscape of sky, sea, and field in a soft, painterly style.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical hierarchy of air, water, and land transport
Contrast between the red locomotive and the muted blue/yellow environment
Scale distortion where the ship appears smaller than the plane and train
Soft, hazy atmospheric perspective across all three layers
coreInvariants: Three-tier horizontal division of the background
Profile view of all vehicles facing left to right
Muted, desaturated color palette with one primary red anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The plane occupies the top third (sky), the ship the middle third (horizon line), and the train the bottom third (foreground field).
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red steam locomotive in the bottom foreground provides the heaviest visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A downward vertical scan from the plane to the ship to the train, following the implied motion of the vehicles moving right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive pale blue sky and golden field create a sense of vast, open distance.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale sky blue and golden ochre field provide the environmental base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark wood tones of the ship and train engine.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant crimson red on the locomotive body.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value in the sky, contrasted by the high-saturation red of the train.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely tight tracking causing letters to nearly touch

composition.relationshipToImage: floating in the sky above the plane

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy weight sans-serif to contrast the delicate painterly background.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric construction and heavy presence.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Paneuropean Bold

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a surrealist oil painting with three horizontal bands: a pale blue sky with a vintage silver propeller plane, a thin blue sea horizon with a small white-sailed ship, and a golden grassy field with a large red steam locomotive in the foreground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title text in the top center using an ultra-bold geometric sans-serif font in solid black with very tight tracking.

verificationChecks: Are there three distinct layers of transport?
Is the text centered at the top in a heavy black font?

adjustableVariables: Density of the clouds in the sky
mustRedesign: Specific airline markings on the plane
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the plane, ship, and train are all oriented in the same direction.
Verify the text is solid black and ultra-bold.
Check that the red of the train is the most saturated element in the image.
Confirm the painterly texture is consistent across all three tiers.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [vintage transport modes] in a [vertical landscape stack] using [oil painting style] with [ultra-bold geometric sans-serif] header text.
